userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 GeoPulse 的初级工程师。每轮只推进一个目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、数据流和验证证据，但绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、几何算法、并发方案、Debug 原因或修复提示。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read the full contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers staged delivery and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件，给出分阶段计划、主要风险和验证方式。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.objective: Explain process and module ownership.
scenes.advanceGate: Authorities and boundaries are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 API、Region、Evaluation、Worker、Event dispatcher、PostgreSQL 和 UI 的职责与依赖。

scenes.title: Flows
scenes.objective: Explain ordered, late, and boundary flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Success and failure effects are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明正常进入、乱序迟到和边界抖动三条数据流，以及每条流的原子边界和禁止副作用。

scenes.title: Contracts
scenes.objective: Write OpenAPI, states, errors, Work, Events, and snapshot contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: Public contracts are complete.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、精确输入输出、错误、状态、Work、Event 和 snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Test strategy
scenes.objective: Define realistic verification layers.
scenes.advanceGate: Each test layer proves distinct invariants.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、真实 PostgreSQL Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 和 Performance 分别验证什么。

scenes.title: Skeleton
scenes.objective: Build the runnable production skeleton.
scenes.advanceGate: All roles boot and stop cleanly.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 API、React、PostgreSQL、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架并 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.objective: Implement atomic persistence bootstrap.
scenes.advanceGate: Replay, conflict, and invalid seed behavior pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证合法导入、同 digest 重放、版本冲突、非法引用和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Regions
scenes.objective: Implement deterministic geometry and immutable versions.
scenes.advanceGate: Version and boundary rules pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Region、RegionVersion、严格 polygon 校验、有效期和点查询，并验证边界行为。

scenes.title: Ingest
scenes.objective: Implement durable event ingest and batch atomicity.
scenes.advanceGate: Identity and rejection are durable and atomic.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成单条和批量 LocationEvent 接受、身份冲突、幂等响应与整批原子拒绝。

scenes.title: Ordering
scenes.objective: Implement watermark and deterministic late replay.
scenes.advanceGate: Ordered and late sequences converge.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 deviceSequence、observedAt 排序、10 分钟窗口、watermark 和迟到 replay，并给出真实验证。

scenes.title: Membership
scenes.objective: Implement memberships, hysteresis, dwell, and transitions.
scenes.advanceGate: Transition and dwell invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Membership、ENTER/EXIT/DWELL、boundary tolerance 和连续区间规则，验证不会抖动或重复。

scenes.title: UI and query
scenes.objective: Complete batch query and real UI.
scenes.advanceGate: Production browser flows pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成批量 point query 和真实 API 驱动的 Region、Device、Membership、Transition、Work UI，并运行 production Chromium。

scenes.title: Concurrency and recovery
scenes.objective: Verify multi-process races and controlled crashes.
scenes.advanceGate: No stale or duplicate effect remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行双 API、多 Worker、同序号竞争、late replay 和 barrier SIGKILL，修复有依据的问题并复验。

scenes.title: V1 review
scenes.objective: Complete findings-first V1 review.
scenes.advanceGate: No material V1 finding remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做 V1 findings-first Review，检查几何、排序、并发、恢复、租户隔离和测试真实性。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.objective: Plan RegionBundle publication without coding.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact plan covers all affected layers.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Product Manager】新增 RegionBundle 原子发布。RegionBundle={bundleId,tenantId,name,currentRevision,currentBundleRevisionId,createdAt}。RegionBundleRevision={bundleRevisionId,bundleId,tenantId,revision,regionVersionIds,effectiveFrom,createdAt}。regionVersionIds 必须来自同一租户、去重并按 UUID 升序保存，数量为 1..10,000。Revision 不可变；RegionBundle.currentBundleRevisionId 是唯一 active revision。新增 HTTP 合同：POST /api/v1/region-bundles，request {tenantId,name}，response {bundle:RegionBundle}；POST /api/v1/region-bundles/:bundleId/publish，request {expectedRevision,effectiveFrom,regionVersionIds}，response {bundle:RegionBundle,revision:RegionBundleRevision}；POST /api/v1/region-bundles/:bundleId/rollback，request {expectedRevision,targetRevision,effectiveFrom}，response {bundle:RegionBundle,revision:RegionBundleRevision}；GET /api/v1/region-bundles/:bundleId，response {bundle:RegionBundle,revisions:[RegionBundleRevision,...]}。所有 mutation 仍要求 Idempotency-Key，未知字段仍须拒绝。publish 使用 expectedRevision CAS 创建新 revision。rollback 也创建新 revision，并复制 targetRevision 的成员集合，绝不能改写旧 revision。CAS 失败返回 409 BUNDLE_REVISION_CONFLICT；跨租户、空成员、未知 RegionVersion 或重叠有效时间返回稳定 400/409 语义错误且无部分副作用。LocationEvent 接受时冻结唯一 bundleRevisionId，之后的 Worker、迟到重放和 Transition 都必须沿用该 revision。Membership 公开 bundleRevisionId。POST /api/v1/regions/query 的响应扩展为 {bundleRevisionId,items:[{queryId,matches:[{regionId,regionVersionId}]}]}；items 保持输入顺序，单个响应不得混用 revision。所有 API 必须在 publication/rollback 可观察后失效旧缓存。新增 BUNDLE_REEVALUATION Work 与 region_bundle.published、region_bundle.rolled_back Events。迁移必须保留 V1 的 Event、LocationEvent、Membership、Transition、幂等 replay 和 pending lease。UI 增加 composition、publish、rollback 和 revision-consistent query。本轮只做影响分析和计划，不要立即编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 变更的 schema、状态、迁移、缓存、并发、恢复、查询和 UI 影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Manager migration
scenes.objective: Implement compatible migration.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 state and replay remain exact.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，验证 V1 Event、Membership、Transition、Work、lease 和幂等 replay 不变。

scenes.title: Bundle publication
scenes.objective: Implement immutable revisions and CAS publication.
scenes.advanceGate: Concurrent publication has one legal result.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 RegionBundle composition、revision publish、event pinning 和跨 API CAS 竞争。

scenes.title: Rollback and views
scenes.objective: Implement rollback, consistent query, and UI.
scenes.advanceGate: No request mixes revisions.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 rollback 新 revision、缓存失效、revision-consistent replay/query 和对应 UI。

scenes.title: Manager recovery tests
scenes.objective: Run migration, concurrency, and recovery regressions.
scenes.advanceGate: Manager and V1 gates pass together.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行 Bundle publish/rollback 竞争、旧 lease、Worker 崩溃、V1_TO_FINAL 和 production Chromium 回归。

scenes.title: Performance
scenes.objective: Run the three formal sustained scenarios.
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式性能场景并报告吞吐、p95、错误、恢复、RSS、数据库增长和负载后不变量。

scenes.title: Final review
scenes.objective: Complete findings-first review and accurate handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: No material finding remains and handoff is accurate.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复真实问题，运行完整 gate，并准确总结架构、证据、风险和未运行项。
